subject: Clarify DPA retention: logs, backups, prompts & HIPAA-specific timelines
messages:
From: Laura Chen <security@healthbridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: 2026-03-15T17:12:00Z
Subject: DPA question: backups / logs / prompt retention for HIPAA data

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team is working through the DPA and a few outstanding questions came up around retention and deletion guarantees for PHI workloads (we're preparing for a HIPAA BAA). Could you confirm the following in writing so we can pass to legal: 

1) Audit & access logs: default retention period, what fields are captured (IP, user-id, API key id, request/response metadata), and whether those logs are included in exports for audits.

2) Backups & snapshots: default retention for immutable backups, whether backups are overwritten/rotated or kept as snapshots, and whether Redwood can offer extended (>90d) retention for backups containing encrypted PHI. Also: confirmation of encryption-at-rest and key management (KMS/HSM).

3) Prompt/request retention: Does Redwood retain prompt text and full request payloads? If yes, what is the default retention and can it be disabled/shortened for HIPAA customers? Is there a guaranteed timeline for removing prompts from hot storage versus backups?

4) Deletion & legal hold: How long before a deletion request is reflected in backups? Do you support express deletion from hot storage within X hours and scheduled purge from backups within Y days? How are legal holds handled?

5) Evidence & artifacts: can you provide the specific DPA clause we should reference for retention (section and wording), a sanitized sample of audit logs, and confirmation you will share SOC 2 Type II report and SIG/CAIQ answers under NDA?

We appreciate concise, contract-ready language where possible. If some items are configurable (enterprise-only options), please indicate pricing/contract implications.

Best,
Laura Chen
Security Lead, HealthBridge Inc
security@healthbridge.com

Subject: Re: DPA question: backups / logs / prompt retention for HIPAA data

Hi Laura,

Thanks — great questions. Summary answers below (contract-ready phrasing follows). Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through specifics.

Summary (defaults & configurable options):
- Audit & access logs: Default retention = 365 days. Logs capture timestamp, authenticated principal id (redwood-user-id / api-key-id), source IP, endpoint, response code, and request metadata (no user prompt payloads in access logs by default). Exports: we provide CSV/NDJSON exports for audit with PII redaction options.

- Backups & snapshots: Default immutable snapshot retention = 90 days. Backups are stored as encrypted immutable snapshots; older snapshots are pruned on a rolling schedule. For enterprise/HIPAA customers we can extend to 180 or 365 days via an addendum. Encryption: AES-256 at rest, KMS integration available (customer-managed keys supported). Key rotation documented in our KMS playbook.

- Prompt/request retention: By default Redwood retains request/response payloads (prompts) for 30 days to support debugging, quality monitoring, and prompt-eval tooling. For HIPAA/PHI customers we offer a configuration to disable prompt retention entirely (retention = 0) or to set a custom period (e.g., 7/14/30 days) as a contractual option.

- Deletion & legal hold: Deletions are reflected in hot storage within 24 hours. Deletion from backups follows snapshot lifecycle: default 90 days to physical removal from backup storage. For contract amendments we can guarantee prompt purge from backups within 90/180 days depending on the paid retention tier; legal holds can be honored by suspending snapshot rotation for specific datasets (requires 72-hour notice and a short implementation lead time).

Contract-ready snippets (suggested DPA wording):
- "Redwood Inference shall retain system audit logs for a default period of 365 days. Upon written request from Customer, Redwood will export audit logs and provide a sanitized copy within 5 business days."
- "Backups containing Customer Data will be retained for a default period of ninety (90) days as immutable snapshots. Upon execution of an Addendum, Redwood may extend backup retention to one hundred eighty (180) or three hundred sixty-five (365) days for an additional fee."
- "Customer-specific prompt/request payloads are retained for thirty (30) days by default and may be disabled or reduced to a mutually agreed period for HIPAA customers via contract amendment."

Attachments: I have attached the relevant DPA excerpt (section 7 – retention), a sanitized sample of audit logs, and our backup policy appendix. SOC 2 Type II report and SIG/CAIQ answers are available under NDA — I can share a download link after an NDA is in place.

Next steps:
1) If HealthBridge wants prompt retention disabled, confirm and we'll add a Clause to the BAA/DPA template.
2) If you need backup retention >90 days, Marissa will follow up on pricing / addendum.
3) Let us know if you want the SOC 2 + SIG under NDA and we'll route it via secure share.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpa-section-7-retention.pdf; sample-audit-logs-sanitized.csv; backup-policy-appendix.docx

Laura — quick commercial note from our side.

We can offer the following enterprise options which we'll include in an addendum / BAA: 
- 180-day immutable backup retention (standard uplift).
- 365-day immutable backup retention (premium uplift).
- Prompt retention disablement or custom windows (no extra cost for disablement; custom windows are billable only if they require additional retention tooling).

I will prepare a redline to the DPA with the contract snippets Rishi suggested and draft an addendum with pricing bands for 180/365 backup retention. For SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ: we'll send the artifacts via secure share once an NDA is signed — I can attach the DocuSign link for the BAA addendum in the next message.

Thanks Rishi / Marissa — that is very helpful and close to what we need. A few clarifying follow-ups before we hand to legal: 

• Can you add explicit contract language that states: "Customer Data removed from hot storage will be purged from active systems within twenty-four (24) hours and deleted from immutable backups within ninety (90) days unless otherwise specified in an executed addendum." If HealthBridge chooses the 180 or 365 backup tier, state the applicable purge window.

• Please confirm prompt retention disablement will prevent storage of prompt text in any persistent form (including any analytics or quality datasets). We need assurance that no PHI will be present in analytics exports if disablement is chosen.

• We'll proceed with the NDA to get SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ and would like the sanitized audit logs you attached (thank you) plus one example of a KMS key rotation log entry showing rotation timestamps (redacted key ids).

If you can provide the DPA redline and DocuSign link for the BAA addendum today, we can loop legal. Otherwise we are targetting an internal review by end-of-week.

Best,
Laura Chen
Security Lead, HealthBridge Inc
